Decision Statements (If...Then...Else):
1. General Format: If condition Then ' Executes when True Else ' Executes when False (Optional) End If
2. Syntax Rules: • "Then" must be on the same line as "If". • "Else" and "End If" must stand alone. • Every Block If must end with "End If".
